policy.frozen_attempt_policy: Frozen attempts are never reclassified or rerun. An INVALID attempt consumes its number; the next attempt takes the next number.

arming.note: The env var takes the NAME, not the number: lorieGateATestFaultPublishFromEnv calls gateATestCellFromName (InitOutput.c), which looks the string up in gateATestCellNames and returns 0 for anything unknown. A numeric value would resolve to 0 and the X server would fatal-halt with x-test-fault-env before the cell ever ran.

cells.name: fresh session recovery after F1's fatal
cells.precondition: R9-F1 PASS with its expected fatal. §8.8: if that fatal does not exist, F2 is BLOCKED, and manufacturing another fatal to satisfy the precondition is FORBIDDEN.
construction: start a genuinely fresh session: a new X process and a new Activity process
drive one clean direct exact composite
forbid: manufacturing another fatal to satisfy the precondition
judging residue against an unwindowed logcat capture — the obs sink survives process death and `logcat -c` is a redline (Q11-F2); logcat-since.txt must be recorded
inferring the Activity died from socket closure alone (Q11-F1); (PID, starttime) is required
cells.pass_requires: new nonce AND empty registry AND a clean direct SUCCESS with event=5 in the ring
invalid: F1's expected fatal absent -> BLOCKED, not INVALID
neither the telemetry events nor the counters were observed -> INVALID REGISTRY_COUNTERS_NOT_OBSERVED, never a pass
cells.fail: stale residue present, or no direct success
cells.require_note: empty_registry_both_sides is measured from the LIVE telemetry stream, not from the c25/c26 summary counters. REGISTER_READY (event 1) and UNREGISTER_ACK (event 25) are traced per buffer id and per role unconditionally, so what each side still holds is (ready - acked) per role; 0 and 0 is the registry empty on both sides. The counters exist only when lorieGateADumpSummary ran, which needs a fatal, a clean close or a terminate, and a healthy F2 has none of those. Measured on r9-f2/attempt-01: gatea-summary.txt empty on a run whose registry demonstrably emptied itself (ids 6 and 7, event 1 then event 25 on both roles). Forcing a dump with SIGTERM was tried and REJECTED: it does not reach CloseScreen in this build and it fatals the renderer with r-hup, which the judge then reads - correctly - as UNEXPECTED_FATAL_IN_FRESH_SESSION.
cells.evidence_note: new_session_nonce is read from GATEA_SUMMARY when a dump exists and otherwise from GATEA_BIND, which logs lorieGateALoadU64Acquire(&state->gateA.sessionNonce) and .generation (activity.cpp:202-203) BEFORE latching them (:219-220) - i.e. a real read of the shared words, not the renderer's private copy. The record says which source it used in shared_tuple_source, and renderer_bound_* stays a separate field: the two halves have different lifetimes and are never merged.

product_level_finding: GATE A HAS NO REACHABLE GENERATION BOUNDARY AT ALL. The bump path (InitOutput.c:565-589) is correctly built and runs exactly once per X process: the first lorieActivityConnected() takes the generation == 0 branch and sets generation 1. A second one is unreachable. A clean close zeroes sessionNonce as well as generation (InitOutput.c:3334-3335, Q10), so it is terminal; and an Activity death fatals X unless generationFatal is ALREADY set, while every way to set generationFatal exits the X process in the same breath (COLD2-ROUTE-SEARCH.md §C-§E). Consequence: lorieGateARegistryCloseGeneration (cmdentrypoint.cpp:380) has no runtime caller, and x-bump-unterminal (cmdentrypoint.cpp:391) and x-share-in-lease (InitOutput.c:570) are defensive-only. Corroboration, not proof: across all recorded evidence (201989 GATEA_EVENT lines) generation has never been observed above 1. Belongs to D-06; recorded, not decided.
